Farms.name: Farms
Farms.description: Agroikiai were plots and communal fields producing grain, olives, and figs, forming the economic base of each polis through seasonal labor, and varied in ownership between shared land and rural households.

Barracks.name: Barracks
Barracks.description: A Hoploteria was a muster yard, where citizens drilled in phalanx discipline and maintained the warrior ethos. In early Greek communities, military service was heavily tied to political rights.
Barracks.benefit2: % experience chance for all contingents from this province

Markets.name: Markets
Markets.description: Agorai were civic squares where traders, craftsmen, and citizens gathered, serving as centers of exchange, public debate, and social life.

Port.name: Port
Port.description: A Limen is a coastal harbor that supports shipwrights, merchants, and fishermen, linking this province to Aegean trade networks and fleet construction.
Port.benefit2: cost to build a fleet or merchant

Prestige.name: Prestige
Prestige.description: Hiera were sacred precincts where communities honored local gods, held festivals, and reinforced shared identity through ritual, myth, and offerings central to civic cohesion.
